key_points: Berenberg downgraded NKE to Sell, citing irreversible market structure shift.
Stock trading near 13‑year low; premarket slid after downgrade.
China sales fell ~12% YoY, weighing on core brand performance.
Dividend yield now roughly equivalent to a 2‑year Treasury, highlighting distress.
Barclays maintains a Buy rating post‑earnings reset, offering a counter‑view.
